csv_project_name: DB Service for Tinker Air Force Base MACC
csv_scope_of_work: The scope of work for this contract at Tinker Air Force Base involves performing construction, renovation, repair, and infrastructure improvements across multiple base facilities as assigned through individual Task Orders. The work may include mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, civil, architectural, and utility systems, along with supporting activities such as design development (when required), submittals, testing, inspections, and final closeout documentation. The Owner (U.S. Government / Contracting Officer and representatives) is responsible for defining the requirements, issuing Task Orders, reviewing and approving designs and submittals, monitoring construction quality and schedule compliance, conducting inspections, and formally accepting completed work.
